# Cloudmersive Document Conversion: Convert PDF to Word DOCX

Converts a PDF document to Word DOCX.

```
GET https://connect.mindcloud.co/v1/universal/cloudmersiveDocumentConversion/latest/actions/convert-pdf-to-docx
```

Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer $MINDCLOUD_API_KEY` and pass a Cloudmersive Document Conversion `connectionId` ([setup](../authentication.md)).

## Example request

```bash
curl -X GET "https://connect.mindcloud.co/v1/universal/cloudmersiveDocumentConversion/latest/actions/convert-pdf-to-docx?connectionId=$CONNECTION_ID&inputFile=JVBERi0xLjMKJcTl8uXrp%2FOg0MTGCjMgMCBvYmoKPDwgL0ZpbHRlciAvRmxhdGVEZWNvZGUgL0xlbmd0aCA1NTAwID4%2BCnN0cmVhbQp4AaWcTY8cx5GG7%2FUr6tgEqOZUfzdgGJApG%2BDCFCRovHvY9YEaUbKMaUqakQj%2F%2FI3IjHgiqrJY0yNBB5aiIt%2BM74zMyp5f%2Bq%2F7X%2Fob%2BW9%2F3q83p%2F60G9anc%2F%2Fwvv%2Bf%2FkP%2F6vXj0N899kP57%2FFO%2BIzhIgMO%2Fj%2F3%2Bj%2FdZzfr4eZ8Pu13%2Fb0wjv73X%2F33ZabdZn3ebc6bfn9YH87l4ea83gqtP8q7zV4eHt53s3MPu9P6OGz742m%2FHs7Hob%2F0u91hvT8cg3QfpOFcuLr7noFGEvFUHkQ4nE4OuN%2Be1vuTYEMT3YzWHY6byic0Fz%2FRxpjOK4YC02n3XdAEqSiTMYM2xnR6xjSaqBmYO%2FGEGihjBm2M6fTA7A5Oy5ibXYsZtDGm0y9JT6dlzBuze5YzaGNMo3chZ38IXnTfn1sfJVrG7KAnTGhJzv2x9VGiCWYnXrBwdt6M6bSMeWh9tDea%2BDLLKcFmvBnTaRlz1%2Fio2wdtjOn0jOm0jLlxHyUdoU3kdHrGdFrGHKqPNGaxm9Gmubl3esZ0WmB2u3Pro0Qb6Q49YUJLubk7tT5KtDGm82ZMo%2BXc3B0aH%2FWJNsZ03ks%2FSA3ZDYd9l3id1u%2B22yY3E22M6bwpNxMvebQbji1m0MaYRs%2B5mcd7%2FdvdDC1m0DJmB2%2B2Z%2FAi59YXgxRLiSaYEbfQEya0iKV%2Be6hLR66fTpvmptNlMQqZ0njXfbtvfNQlWta9h54x03gwt%2B6jpCO0cW5unX7pN8f9eiuLNKT7IN3ULMqZuTXaNDOhZymD163Rbc5tFiXaSHPoCRNayszNsc2iRBtjOm%2FGNFrOzM3eK11UpUQbYzpvYHaJ13XvN9LTTFfiRBtjOm%2FKzMQbmJu20m2CNsY0es7MxBuYw4yPgpYxu43TQ%2FceWsqi4dz6KNEEM6IWesKEljGPrY8Go00z0%2BmSmadBmrrzrod0H6Sd51B4fTBag%2Bi8WUqnZSm3TZ3rhqBla0phN96M6bSMOVjTK1nga%2BYAbZzr0DNm8OL1Mx0ykEaa5rqTE6CTkoynWuJy8TDSFM%2FJdWHbnmRD4CRp16W%2BFdKhuibjGcnwXn3V%2F%2BlP%2Fau3r998IRuUP%2F%2B5%2F8sXr8tm5qaXvcovQtOdjWxefOew1e3HcejuLv1fbvv9vry3f24v%2FavbW93p3H7f%2F2%2B%2F%2BvuL%2Fma96Vc%2FPby3p4v927%2F5%2BfGF7m%2Fk7W%2BXF90%2F%2B9v%2F6v96Kxucv7593WehNi5UyIKpD1KGD5vh3Fdhhl0VtvzTVWE2WZg6308%2BsUpVSZdenmQrtR761Y9O%2FNkfHn97oTszETXzfeevwbtvKA8J99GAu9WvbgTht0nf%2BdALMjnXy5b7zqbsVh983CPj7nwgFCf85sxZLJu5W6FPawAoj3c8MvMPjoqu3YqpMQnjXJh1q9YXjoRFP7jhAbxjFvEGVvsP8BeUfBTOCKu56NmfS%2FRYKI%2Bip59GD1OBj95Q3ru0RUZtMfoV46rglfiLK8pQ2GqEKVu3wniw4Vsoj6PwqPAYy7i6VRLo4V8%2BebKypcFdwKYRiPGj69eqDg%2BKJIDwE2yYSnLLJmckgQhlFCtVx29Q8juXKs3oudaPc60OBbbNt ```
```

```js
const params = new URLSearchParams({
  connectionId,
  "inputFile": ""
});

const response = await fetch(`https://connect.mindcloud.co/v1/universal/cloudmersiveDocumentConversion/latest/actions/convert-pdf-to-docx?${params}`, {
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.MINDCLOUD_API_KEY}`
  }
});

const { success, data } = await response.json();
```

## Inputs

Arguments are sent as query string parameters ([conventions](../arguments.md)).

| Key | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `inputFile` | file | yes | Input PDF document to convert to Word DOCX. Default: ``. |

## Response

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "outputFile": "string"
    }
  ],
  "meta": {}
}
```

### Response fields

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `outputFile` | string | Converted Word DOCX file content returned by Cloudmersive. |

## Native endpoint

Through the native Cloudmersive Document Conversion API, this operation is `POST /convert/pdf/to/docx` (base URL `https://api.cloudmersive.com`). The Universal API call above is translated to it by MindCloud, including authentication. See the [native action reference](../../native-api/actions/convert-pdf-to-docx.md) for the provider-specific parameters and requirements.
